SELECT a.ano AS ano, a.astatus AS astatus, a.adate AS adate,
j.jno AS jno, j.jtitle AS jtitle,
m.mno AS applicantMno, m.mname AS applicantName, m.memail AS applicantEmail,
r.rno AS rno, r.rtitle AS rtitle, r.rjobrole AS rjobrole, r.rsummary AS rsummary, r.rcreate AS rcreate, r.rupdate AS rupdate
FROM application a JOIN job_posting j ON j.jno = a.jno JOIN company c ON c.cno = j.cno JOIN member m ON m.mno = a.mno LEFT JOIN resume r ON r.rno = a.rno WHERE a.ano = #{ano} AND c.mno = #{companyMno}
